purpose: Adjudicate the exact current JimLiu/baoyu-skills catalog at Skill granularity without executing third-party code, installing a Skill, or treating a source-catalog count as an admission decision.

source.commitSubject: 更新 baoyu-wechat-summary 技能：调整输出顺序并拆分环境/群记忆参考文件
source.acquisition: single exact-commit fetch into a bare non-active Git object root

catalogSurface.countExplanation: The repository has 21 paths explicitly listed in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plus .claude/skills/release-skills. A scanner that searches every SKILL.md can therefore report 22 even though the published plugin declares 21 user-facing Skills.

upstreamQualityEvidence.remoteCheckObservationDetails: Exact-commit GitHub check-run observation could not be retrieved because the local HTTPS credential layer failed for both PowerShell and curl, while exact Git transport and remote-main identity succeeded.

dependencyBoundary.runtimeFamily: Most script-bearing Skills expect bun or npx -y bun; installation or implicit package download is a later setup and trust transition.
dependencyBoundary.reason: Those imports are supplied only by the repository-root package manifest, not by a manifest inside the selectively copied Skill directory used by the current manager layout.

currentOverlap.interpretation: Backend or carrier overlap does not erase Baoyu's higher-level methods. The three selected method candidates explicitly prefer a current native image backend and add article, cover, or infographic structure. Static overlap still proves neither incremental behavior nor value.

items.name: release-skills
items.reason: This repository-maintainer workflow is outside the 21 paths declared by the plugin and governs releases, tags, pushes, and GitHub Releases already covered by repository rules and current GitHub/Superpowers routes.

items.name: baoyu-article-illustrator
items.reason: Adds a reproducible article-level illustration plan, prompt records, confirmation gate, and backend-neutral composition while explicitly preferring the current native image backend. First-use preferences and generated files remain task-time writes.

items.name: baoyu-comic
items.reason: The educational-comic method is substantive but specialized, depends on image generation, and its PDF script imports root-only pdf-lib under selective manager installation.

items.name: baoyu-compress-image
items.reason: Image compression is useful, but the selective directory has no sharp manifest, Windows tool detection uses which, and the default non-keep path can rename or replace originals. It needs a dependency and destructive-semantics comparison before admission.

items.name: baoyu-cover-image
items.reason: Adds a bounded five-dimension cover workflow and confirmation boundary on top of a native-first image backend without shipping executable code. Preference and output writes remain task-bound.

items.name: baoyu-danger-gemini-web
items.reason: Uses an unofficial reverse-engineered Gemini Web surface, browser authentication, cached cookies, and explicit consent. Current official image generation remains the default route.

items.name: baoyu-danger-x-to-markdown
items.reason: Uses an unofficial X surface with tokens or browser cookies, account risk, consent state, and optional media download. It is not a general inactive admission candidate.

items.name: baoyu-diagram
items.reason: Direct SVG generation is a useful account-free diagram method, but the required final PNG conversion imports root-only sharp. Exact selective installation is not dependency-complete.

items.name: baoyu-electron-extract
items.reason: Reads and reconstructs installed application bundles and may format extracted source. It requires a bound app, rights and data boundary, exact output root, and user-authorized writes.

items.name: baoyu-format-markdown
items.reason: Provides a careful formatting method and complete local manifest, but overlaps Documents and edit-article, creates analysis and formatted artifacts, and offers an in-place typography branch. Compare on a bound content task before adding another ambient route.

items.name: baoyu-image-gen
items.reason: The current official imagegen route is preferred. This alternative adds many provider keys, endpoints, network calls, concurrency, Codex CLI spawning, and persistent configuration and is only eligible for a proved provider-specific gap.

items.name: baoyu-infographic
items.reason: Adds a source-preserving layout and visual-style method, prompt record, confirmation gate, and explicit native image-backend preference without executable code. Behavioral value remains unproved.

items.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
items.reason: The conversion method is carrier-specific and depends on baoyu-md and baoyu-chrome-cdp packages, with optional browser rendering. Keep it with a bound WeChat publishing need rather than general admission.

items.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
items.reason: Crosses WeChat account credentials, API or browser control, uploads, draft creation, and optional SSH proxying. It requires task-time authority and final publication control.

items.name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
items.reason: Fills Weibo posts and articles through Chrome CDP and leaves final publication to the user. Account and public-write boundaries make it task-time only.

items.name: baoyu-post-to-x
items.reason: Composes current Chrome or computer-use controls and CDP fallbacks, with media uploads and an explicit final publish gate. It remains an account-bound public-write route.

items.name: baoyu-slide-deck
items.reason: Current official Presentations already owns deck carriers. Baoyu's image-deck method may be compared on a bound task, but its PDF and PPTX scripts import root-only pdf-lib and pptxgenjs.

items.name: baoyu-translate
items.reason: The three-mode translation and glossary method is substantive and dependency-complete, but blocks first use on persistent EXTEND.md creation and may spawn one subagent per chunk. Existing access/communication evidence says the next gap is behavior, accessibility, and recipient evidence rather than another ambient route.

items.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
items.reason: Adds a substantial browser/CDP extraction stack, site adapters, login and CAPTCHA waits, snapshots, and network data boundaries already partially covered by current browser and Chrome routes.

items.name: baoyu-wechat-summary
items.reason: Requires macOS WeChat, an external wx-cli, private chat history, persistent profiles and group memory, and instructs disabling the sandbox for every command. It is neither portable nor suitable for broad admission.

items.name: baoyu-xhs-images
items.reason: The style and layout system is reusable but optimized for a specific social-content carrier and overlaps the selected infographic and cover methods. Revisit for a bound Xiaohongshu or image-card workload.

items.name: baoyu-youtube-transcript
items.reason: Fetches YouTube data, caches media metadata, retries alternate identities, and may fall back to yt-dlp. The instruction to make yt-dlp available cannot override the Harness installation authority gate.

nextGate: Keep the three native-image-backend method candidates inactive behind the atomic default-disabled manager gap, preserve the other methods as exact comparison metadata, and continue the bounded cohort with K-Dense representative scientific Skill review.
